watches.name: Biotic Formicidae
watches.description: A 39 mm automatic field watch inspired by the navigation instincts of ants. Powered by the Miyota 9015 movement, it features dual screw-down crowns, an internal compass bezel, 200 m water resistance, and ant-themed design details — including a custom-illustrated sapphire caseback. Built for exploration, designed with purpose.
